description: Variation of Condition 15 (Tree Retention/Removal & Protection Plan), Condition 17 (Landscaping) and Condition 2 (Approved plans) following planning permission 00733/H/P3 dated 22/04/2021
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (see attached schedule) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Construction Phase (Heath, Safety and Environment) Plan, Version 4. Received: 19/02/2019, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(3) on 15 April 2019.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Cover Letter dated 22nd February 2019. Received: 25/02/2019. WH191/18/45.03 - Typical Roof Details Sheet 3 of 4; WH191_18_P-95.02 Rev: P2 - Schedule of Proposed External Materials Block B Elevation; WH191_18_P-95.01 Rev: P2 - Schedule of Proposed External Materials Block B Elevation; WH191/18/75.76 Rev: B - Typical Boiler Cupboard Detail; WH191 18_P _95.03 Rev:P2 - Schedule of Proposed External Materials Bay Study. Received: 02/08/2019 Email from Jack Riggs (Weston Homes) to Sam Smith (LBH) with subject "Re: Manor Lane, Feltham - Application Ref. No. 00733/H/P1(5) Deemed Discharge Notice" received on: 07 August 2019 12:43:50; Received: 07/08/2019. WH191 18_P _95.01 Rev: B - General Balcony Details. Received: 22/08/2019. WH191/18/75.1000 Rev: B - Parapet Sketch. Received: 27/08/2019; as approved under application 00733/H/P1(5) approved on 30 August 2019; and WH191_18_P_95.01 Rev P3	 Schedule of Proposed External Materials Block A Elevation received on 30/10/2020.

Condition : 5 - No part of the development shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities, as shown on the approved plans, have been provided and made available for use by residents. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.
Condition : 6 - Each residential unit shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans.
Condition : 7 - A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided as identified on the approved plans.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with SES Letter (Ref. SES/SP/EH) dated 6th June RE: WH191 Tesco, Manor Lane, Feltham: Condition 9 Scheme for Acoustic Insulation. Received: 10/06/2019, as approved under 00733/H/P1(9) on 01 November 2019.
Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed as approved before any part of the development within the relevant phase is first occupied.

Condition : 9 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with WH191/18/15.04 RevD - Private Drainage; Hounslow DAF (April 2019); Greenfield Run Off Calculations; WH191/18/15.03 RevC - Levels; SUDS Maintenance and Management Plan (April 2019) Received: 09/05/2019, and approved under application 00733/H/P1(10) on 10 June 2019.

Condition : 10 - a.	The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Phase I Desk Study and Preliminary Risk Assessment; Phase II Ground Investigation and Generic Risk Assessment Report Version 2; Remediation Method Statement. Received: 18/02/2019 as approved under application 00733/H/P1(11) on 13 March 2019.
b.	The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Phase I Desk Study and Preliminary Risk Assessment; Phase II Ground Investigation and Generic Risk Assessment Report Version 2; Remediation Method Statement. Received: 18/02/2019 as approved under application 00733/H/P1(11) on 13 March 2019.
During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use: 
d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval for block A. 
The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be carried out as approved under application 00733/H/P3(11D) on 23 February 2023 for block B.

Condition : 11 - a.	The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Energy and Sustainability Report, Version 4. Received: 15/02/2019, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(12) on 09 May 2019.

b.	The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Block A compliance Report; Block A SAP reports; Block B Compliance Report; Block B SAP reports. Received: 26/03/2019, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(12i) on 10 May 2019.

c.	Upon final commencement of operation of the solar PV panels, suitable devices for the monitoring of the solar PV panels shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring web-platform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 12 - The development has must be constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations which will not exceed 105 litres/per person/per day, as approved under application 00733/H/P3(13) on 03 February 2023.
Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved details, as approved under application 00733/H/P3(14) on 03 February 2023.

Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with BHA_447_01 REV E - Combined Tree Retention/Removal and Protection Plan Received: 29/11/2022, as approved under this application 00733/H/P4.

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan dated Jan 2019. Received: 19/02/2019, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(16) on 16 April 2019.

Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18129-D3-02 Rev: 04, Concept Section 01; 18129-D6-01 Rev: 09. Planting Plan 01; 18129-D6-02 Rev: 09. Planting Plan 03. Received: 16/06/2020, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(17) on 03 July 2020; and Planting plan 02. Reference 18129-D6-02 Rev 10. Prepared by Weston Homes, Concept plan 01- Master plan. Reference: 18129-D3-01 Rev 12. Prepared by Studio 31- Landscape architects as approved under this application 00733/H/P4.

All landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within three years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained in accordance with the approved management programme.
Condition : 17 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved documents, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(18) on 12/12/2021.

Condition : 18 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the parking, loading and turning spaces as set out in the approved plans, shall be constructed and made available for use. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter.

Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with WH191_Con20_P_01 RevP4, Cycle Parking; WH191_Con20_P_02 RevP1, Sheffield Hoop Details; Letter WH to LBH 02/07/2020; WH191_Con20_P_01a RevP2, Cycle Parking_Uplifted Option; and Easylift Premium Two-Tier Specification Sheet. Received: 02/07/2020, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(20) approved on 03/07/2020.
The approved details shall be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Condition : 20 - The car parking areas shall be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan, as approved under application 00733/H/P3(21) approved on 21/10/2022.

Condition : 21 - The building shall not be occupied until all means of access for pedestrians and cyclists including any necessary associated highway works and closure of existing redundant accesses have been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 22 - All deliveries and servicing of the site shall be managed in compliance with the approved Delivery & Servicing Plan, as approved under application 00733/H/P3(23) approved on 18/05/2022.

Condition : 24 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measures from the nearest sensitive receptors. Plant shall be set in from the roof boundaries by a minimum of 2m and shall have a non-galvanised steel finish. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 25 - No later than September 2023, a Secured by Design Silver certificate and summary compliance sheet (or such equivalent standard) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has incorporated the best practice design guidance contained within Secured by Design Homes 2016.
Condition : 26 - Any boilers installed shall be Ultra Low Emission (<40mgNOx/kWh).

Condition : 27 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with WH191_Con28_P_01 Rev: P1; WH191_Con28_P_02 Rev: P1 WH191_Con28_P_03 Rev: P3; Unnumbered Indicative Perspective View From 1st Floor Balcony. Received: 20/07/2020, as approved under application 00733/H/P1(28i) approved on 08 September 2020.
